manualReviewReference: GitHub Actions run 39734999767 artifact 12407265371, 85 full-illustration/footer contact sheets; sample sheets reviewed for energy and tournament prints.
disposition: 108 are separate legitimate no-number / catalog-only ordinal cards, not 108 newly verified printed numeric footers. Preserve all 108 unique catalogue entries and images.
identityRules: Card master code is an internal catalogue key; never assert it was visibly printed on an unnumbered Korean card.
Images are Korean-reading card fronts or event/energy prints; source SHA256 distinct for all 108; no Japanese substitution accepted.
Do not merge identical energy names across distinct package releases. Image hashes and series retain different variant identity.
A visual confidence claim about individual years or foil finish requires dedicated authentic print evidence beyond ordinal/URL.
